episodes.title: My Story on Joining an Online Cult.
episodes.description:
After about over 6 hours of redoing this as a 1 take and rushing to get it done I had this recorded and edited from early October before learning about the Death of the LCU and my stream with Tech where we called out all the atrocities that I missed out before recording this video.

Any opinions of anyone that I had here, amplify by 10x since the October 7th Crew. This includes my opinion of Xylie flipping even from utter disbelief.

If there's anything in this video that you may see as inconsistent or don't agree with, check out Techs stream where I come back https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9lMCekCmgas&t=6832s and use that as a newest take, even though my takes of people here may be outdated, my thoughts are still the same and I love and appreciate everyone who has supported me throughout my journey.

This video isn't meant to be drama slop (although it can be if you want it to) but in actuality more of a message to my viewers who just want to hear my thoughts and ask questions directly. Feel free to leave a comment and have a wonderful day!
